name: clean_docker
description: Clean install in LXC, start services in Docker, start MCP over SSE, index repo and run a search.

steps.description: Create/ensure the base LXC container and snapshot, install dependencies (docker/git/curl), start Docker service.
Create a new ephemeral test container from the base snapshot.
steps.name: ${scenario_name}-${timestamp}

steps.description: Copy prebuilt binaries into the container and mark them executable.
Run the installer inside the container (Ollama+Qdrant in Docker mode).
Place the MCP server binary in the installed bin directory (so later commands match expected paths).
Start the MCP server in the background (SSE transport) and write logs to /root/mcp.log.
Wait until the SSE endpoint responds (server is ready).
Clone the target repository that will be indexed and searched.
Optionally checkout a fixed git ref (tag/commit) for deterministic runs.
cmd: cd '${repo_dir}' && git fetch --tags --force >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; git checkout -f '${repo_ref}'

steps.description: Open an MCP session over SSE and perform MCP initialize + initialized notification.
Index (or reindex) the repo workspace so semantic search works.
steps.name: rag_index_workspace

steps.description: Run a deterministic exact search and assert the tool returns success.
steps.name: rag_search_code

arguments.query: SearchLocalIndexTool implements the rag_search_code MCP tool.
